target_customer: Enterprises and professional services firms deploying third-party AI tools
problem: Companies either ban AI tools or use them without oversight, and benchmarks do not show real deployment behavior. Tecto offers governance to discover, evaluate, monitor and keep AI tools compliant.
business_model: B2B SaaS, early access and discounted pricing for first customers

founders.name: Niosha Afsharikia
founders.background_notes: Per YC page: about six years consulting on AI adoption for government and private clients; prior employers not named.

founders.name: Roksana Baleshzar
founders.background_notes: Per YC page: 6+ years at Google building ML features in Gmail.

competitors.name: Credo AI
competitors.what: AI governance software to monitor compliance of AI initiatives

competitors.name: Zenity
competitors.what: AI agent security and governance platform
competitors.traction_then: Integrated with ChatGPT Enterprise Compliance API in April 2025

technical_complexity.rationale: Evaluating and monitoring agent behavior across third-party tools needs integrations and evaluation design, moderate for a two person team.

defensibility.rationale: Compliance positioning could help, but funded governance vendors existed before the batch and the team claimed only pilots.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Zenity raised a 125M dollar Series C in August 2026 per a search report, showing the category attracted large capital. No source ties this to Tecto's fate.

market_need_then: The YC page says Tecto was live with law firms and piloting with Big 4 firms and enterprises, a company claim.

branding.domain_note: Uses tecto.ai, the exact name on an .ai domain.

identity.voice_and_tone: HR metaphor: AI employees, resumes, hiring and monitoring

branding.brand_signature: HR system for AI employees metaphor

brand_strength.rationale: The HR metaphor is clear and memorable in the launch post, but no press or community evidence was found.

outcome_analysis: The dataset lists TectoAI as inactive though several directories still show it active, and no shutdown notice or cause was found, so the cause is not public. It faced funded governance vendors and had a team of two with a reported 500 thousand dollars or less.
notes: Website tecto.ai returned HTTP 503. Funding sources conflict: Caplight 500K seed dated July 2025, VCBacked seed April 2025, ZeroG 1.4M, StartupHub 800K, PitchBook 500K. Recorded as one 500K round of stage other. Rests on aggregators only. Status conflict between YC page (Active in search results) and dataset (Inactive).
